config.target: rent YoY direction (signal → rent, the proximate stage of the transmission chain)
config.whyNotPrice: Price appreciation lags rent by an additional 6-12 months; signal → price is too slow + noisy to test cleanly. We validate the fast/clean upstream link, not the slow downstream one.
config.evaluationLeadRule: Each turn is evaluated at the leadMonths of its DOMINANT contributing signal (largest |contribution|, |corr| as tiebreaker). The lead is sourced from the walk-forward lead-lag refit at the turn's asOf — locked before rent outcomes are read, the same number that drove the score that caused the turn. The fixed 3/6/9-month grid is retained alongside as a diagnostic.
